ember_dragon.title: Red Dragon
ember_dragon.story: She hatched from a Ruby that the ash kept warm for sixty years. She is the first fire to come back to Emberkeep.
ember_dragon.personality: Full of energy and always curious. She loves to explore every corner of the island.
ember_dragon.ability: She can fly higher than any other young dragon, and wraps her tail around herself to stay warm at night.

emerald.title: Green Dragon
emerald.story: She hatched from an Emerald that the deep roots kept warm. The Red Dragon is the island's fire; she is its garden.
emerald.personality: Gentle and calm. She looks after things: a wilting plant, a cold nest, a tired Keeper.
emerald.ability: Her breath makes plants grow faster. Berries ripen early when she is near.

frost.title: Frost Dragon
frost.story: She was born in winter, from an egg that never melted. Even in warm Emberkeep she carries a little snow with her.
frost.personality: Calm and careful. She watches for a long time before she moves, and her landings never make a sound.
frost.ability: She breathes a cool frost that calms anything that gets too hot, without putting the fire out.

storm.title: Storm Dragon
storm.story: He cracked his shell inside a thundercloud and rode the storm down to the island. The weather follows him like a puppy.
storm.personality: Restless and crackly. He naps in high places, wakes with the wind, and loves a chase.
storm.ability: His wings charge the air. He can call a small, polite thunder that rattles the windows and makes him very proud.

moonwhisker.title: Moonwhisker
moonwhisker.story: Nobody saw her arrive. One night the moon came up, and she was just there.
moonwhisker.personality: Secretive and moon-led. She keeps her own hours and appears exactly where she wants to be.
moonwhisker.ability: Her whiskers can read moonlight. In the dark she sees the island as clearly as at noon, and finds lost things.

ashdrake.title: Ash Dragon
ashdrake.story: The old nests never got cold. Three eggs stayed warm under the ash for a hundred years, until a Keeper found them.
ashdrake.personality: Patient and watchful, like glowing embers. She remembers every hand that fed her.
ashdrake.ability: She breathes a slow, warm glow that brings cold things back to life. Cracked Rocks are her favourite snack.

rimewyrm.title: Ice Dragon
rimewyrm.story: He waited deep under the ice of Borealis for a very long time. Three eggs, found one by one, finally met their Keeper.
rimewyrm.personality: Quiet and slow to decide. He moves like a glacier: slowly, then all at once.
rimewyrm.ability: He breathes a frosty mist that freezes a moment in place. Frost that keeps things safe, not frost that hurts.
